text.other-projects-label: Hall of fame · six more builds

html.about-intro:
My interest in software began back in late 2019, I was eager to make my own minigames for Minecraft.
Since then, I've had the opportunity to work with the largest Minecraft server in Iran, manage my own dev team of 8, and work on a multitude of open source projects.
html.contact-description:
Whether it's for an opportunity, a question, or a freelance request, my inbox is always open.
Even if you just want to say hi, I’ll try my best to get back to you!
